name: NULL ROOM
desc: NULL ROOM

name: River
desc: An underground river flows swiftly by.

name: Food Store
desc:
You are in the Citadel's food storage area.
Old cheeses and black loaves of bread can be seen, as well as many sacks of supplies.

name: Kitchen
desc: You are in the Citadel's kitchen. A huge joint of meat turns slowly over a raging fire. Doors lead into cupboards, as well as to the west and to the south.

name: Library
desc: This is the Central Library. Leather-bound volumes line the walls, right up to the ornately carved ceiling.

name: Studio
desc: This room is an awful mess. It used to be an artist's studio. Paint and old easels lie around the floor.

name: Entrance
desc:
This is the entrance to the Citadel of Pershu.
Turn now, if you wish. Many stronger than you have taken fright at its menacing towers and dark portals. If you wish to proceed, move east towards the black gaping doorway.

name: Altar
desc: A stone altar stands in the middle of the room with two dead candles on it. An old book lies on one part of the altar top, and a faded red parchment cloth covers the front of it.

name: Black Tower
desc:
You stand high on the black tower, the Citadel stretches to the north, south and east of you.
There is only one way out.

name: North Cellar
desc: You are in the northern section of the Citadel's large wine cellar. Heavy barrels lie all around you in this end of the cellar. There is a door to the north and one to the south.

name: West Cellar
desc: You are in the west wing of the wine cellar. There is a door to the west and one to the east. The central circular part of the cellar lies beyond the east door.

name: Wine Cellar
desc: You are in the central circular area of the wine cellar. There is a door at each compass point.

name: East Cellar
desc: You are in the east section of the wine cellar. There is a door to the west and one - which you cannot use,as it only allows entrance to where you now stand - to the east.

name: South Cellar
desc: There are many, many wine bottles here lying on their sides in this southern section of the wine cellar. There is a dark, unfriendly-looking hole to the west and doors to the north and to the south.

name: Armory
desc: This is the Citadel's armory. Row upon row of shiny suits of armor are stored here.

name: Bedchamber
desc:
You are in the ruler's bedchamber.
A large fire burns in the south of the room, with a small door beside it. Other exits are to the north and to the west.

name: Sand
desc:
Sand covers the floor of this curious room, heaped into drifts.
By peeping over the 'dunes' you can see a golden passage way leads to the west, and there is a door to the south. You are not sure whether or not you have seen all the exits.

name: Gallery
desc: You are in the picture gallery. Portraits of long-dead princes line all of the walls. The room is dominated by a huge landscape, hanging above the exit to the east which leads, via the gold passage way back to that curious room of sand.

name: Tower Balcony
desc:
You are on a remote tower balcony.
There are stairs here.

name: Archway
desc:
You walk beneath a stone archway.
You can only walk north or south unless you decide to take the stairs.

name: Marble Hall
desc:
This vast hall has a marble floor, and the slightest sound echos violently.
There are purple drapes concealing the exits from this hall.

name: Glove Storeroom
desc:
You are in the glove storeroom.
The west door radiates heat.
Another door leads to the south.

name: Silver Storeroom
desc:
You are in the silver crosses storeroom.
There are only two exits.

name: Amulet Storeroom
desc:
You are in the amulet storeroom.
Doors lead north and south.

name: Kazoom Storeroom
desc:
You are in the kazoo storeroom.
There are two exits.

name: Satchel Storeroom
desc: You are in the satchel storeroom.

name: Wooden Storeroom
desc: You are in the storeroom for wooden boxes... There are two exits.

name: Vase Storage
desc: This is where printed vases are stored... As you can easily see.

name: Mine
desc:
The heavy air of this area seems to make your torch very dim-> You can hardly see that air is rushing up from somewhere.
You can just make out that this area must be a mine of some sort.

name: Tunnels
desc:
You appear to be in an endless labyrinth,lined with paintings.........
Whichever way you turn, there seems to be more tunnels, all lined with paintings.

name: South Tower
desc: This is the southern tower of the Citadel.

name: Exit
desc:
Well done, you have managed to find the exit.
Take a deep breath of good, clean air...........

name: Meditation Room
desc: This room is filled with swirling smoke,so you cannot see... Air rushes past a statue of the goddess Diana. This must be the Citadel's meditation chamber.

name: Bridge
desc:
A small forked bridge crosses a stream here.
You can move north, south, or west.

name: Cavern
desc:
You are in a rough stone cavern. Stairs lead up from here.
There is also a single door which leads away from the cavern.

name: Stable
desc: This is the former Citadel underground stable. It smells terrible.

name: Courtyard
desc: You find yourself in an underground courtyard. Strange, twisted trees are around you, and a wind of incredible coldness blows from the east.

name: Oracle
desc: This is the Oracle Room, although the mystic voice has not spoken for many years.

name: Sacrifice Room
desc:
Horrors. A cold shudder passes through you as you realize this is the priests' sacrifice room.
Dried-up blood is on the floor and a skull grins at you from high on the wall.

name: Dungeon
desc: Old straw mattresses and rings chained to the wall tell you this was the Citadel's dungeon. The dungeon seems to stretch forever, with many small partitioned areas....

name: Alcove
desc: You are in a small alcove, with a solid gray granite throne in the middle of it.

name: Orc Guardroom
desc: This is the orc's guardroom, way below the ground. A stairwell ends here and a door leads to the east.

name: Healing Pool
desc: There is a healing pool here, with a dangerous, swirling area of water.

name: Hall of Odric
desc: The Underpriests of Odric used this tiny hall for their forbidden worship eons ago. It is an unpleasant area,so you are thrilled to see a set of stone stairs.

name: DEATH BY DROWNING
desc:
Water covers your head.
You are drowning.
GLUG... GASP............

name: DEATH BY BURNING
desc:
The flames strike at you...
as you slowly burn to death...

name: DEATH BY FREEZING
desc: You are hit by a freezing spell and turn into a block of perpetual living stone. This is the end.

name: BOTTOMLESS PIT
desc:
You tumble down a bottomless pit.
Down, down, down...
